WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS fielding_count
    FROM fielding f
    JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id
    GROUP BY p.bats
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(fielding_count) AS total_count,
           AVG(fielding_count) AS average_count
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT COALESCE(h.batting_hand, '') AS batting_hand,
       h.fielding_count,
       1.0 * h.fielding_count / t.total_count AS share,
       h.fielding_count - t.average_count AS above_average
FROM hand_counts h
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE h.fielding_count > t.average_count;
